body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> IN WIN unveiled its mini PC case supporting Mini-ITX and Mini-DTX at CES Unveiled at CES 2010 in Las Vegas, which can provides flexibility for user who wish to choose specific system components while minimizing overall costs.
The Diva combines a checkered design and modern colors that will surely catch the attention of any fashionista. Available in pink, black, and gold.
With a seemingly small 6.8L volume size, the Diva can accommodate a standard ODD and still allows for a 3.5" HDD and 2.5" HDD to be installed simultaneously.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
